lines.t: Neon Cross
Drown in the noise
My brother's laughing at the change they were
Calling I am freedom in their voice
And I'm walking through their fever dream
With my eyes awake and my hands still clean
Yeah, the city's drunk on its own truth
But I remember you
So R.I.P. to this world's illusion
R.I.P. to the lies I knew
Let it burn in the glare of your fire
I was dead, now I live in you
While the skyline shakes and the idols fall
I'll be feasting at your table
Still in the ruin of a faithless world
You're the only one that's real
Empty churches full of smoking lights
Talking grace with unbending
Golden calves with electric eyes
Selling hope in HD
I see sermons signed by corporations
Profits paid to keep them blind
While the narrow road grows overgrown, they pave the highway to the fire
They say, wake up and you're losing out, but they sleep walking to the edge
I see the storm in the face of the crowd, all dancing on a breaking lead
Still you pull me from their current, seat me where the wine runs true
My soul is the loudest siren, crying, world he has chosen you
So R.I.P. to this world's illusion R.I.P. to the lies I knew
Let it burn in the glare of your fire I was dead, now I live in you
While the skyline shakes and the idols fall I'll be feasting at your table
Still in the ruin of a faithless world You're the only one that's real
We'll be right back.
Let you know
